plugins.name: Autopilot
plugins.description: Watches every inbox feed (Chat, Gmail, Jira: any plugin that offers one) and, when an item matches one of your rules, opens a Claude tab that investigates it with a playbook you wrote, or runs one of the item's own actions (mark read, done) with no Claude at all, optionally only when the Jira issue a mail is about has the status you name (a live lookup through the Jira plugin). Read-only by its prompt unless a rule lists the actions its session may take; off by default; rules, playbooks and your standing instructions (base.md) are files in folders of yours (global ones for every project, and per project), edited in its panel, by hand or with Claude. Needs cc-cockpit 0.11.0.
plugins.author: BronOS

plugins.name: Bricks
plugins.description: A paddle-and-ball brick game in a panel, to play while Claude works. Move the paddle with the mouse or arrows; the hit point sets the angle. Strong bricks show their hits left as notches, capsules widen the paddle, slow the ball or add a ball, and five levels repeat faster. Calm, Normal and Fast speeds with a best score each. It pauses on Space, when the pointer leaves the board, when the panel is hidden and when a Claude tab of the window finishes and waits for you, naming that tab with a button to go to it. Reads only the window's tab statuses; never types into a session, runs nothing and uses no network.
plugins.author: BronOS

plugins.name: Google Calendar
plugins.description: Your Google Calendar beside your Claude tabs: the meeting now and next with a countdown and Join, invitations to answer, today, tomorrow and the next days, reminders before a meeting starts, an event opened in its own window with notes, Ask and Discuss with Claude, and the Jira issue it names beside it (with bronos.jira). It changes nothing in Google Calendar but your answers to invitations. Notes and Ask need cc-cockpit 0.28.0.
plugins.author: BronOS

plugins.name: Google Chat
plugins.description: Your Google Chat in lanes (Mentions, Direct messages, Spaces, Alerts, Recent), sorted by Jev triage, a conversation opened in its own window with notes, Ask and Discuss with Claude, Mark read / Mark unread. It changes nothing in Google Chat but your read state. Notes and Ask need cc-cockpit 0.28.0.
plugins.author: BronOS

plugins.name: Deberc
plugins.description: Deberc, the klaberjass-family card game, in a panel to play while Claude works: four players in pairs with a computer partner, or three each for themselves, first to 501. 32 cards, bid on the turned trump or name another suit, swap the trump 7, follow suit and trump by the rules, terz and 50 melds, bella, the last trick, and a taker who falls when the side scores less. A scoreboard with this deal's points and a score sheet of every deal, Easy and Normal computer players, your wins and losses kept, cards that scale with the panel, trumps marked by a corner tab and a four-colour deck as a setting. When a Claude tab of the window finishes and waits for you, the game pauses and names that tab, with a button to go to it. Reads only the window's tab statuses; never types into a session, runs nothing and uses no network.
plugins.author: BronOS

plugins.name: Durak
plugins.description: Durak, the classic card game (the throw-in kind), against one, two or three computer players in a panel, to play while Claude works. 36 cards, a trump under the deck, attack and defend, throw in by rank, take or beat; whoever runs out once the deck is empty is safe and the last one holding cards is the durak. Easy and Normal opponents, your wins and losses kept, cards that scale with the panel, trumps marked by a corner tab and a four-colour deck as a setting. When a Claude tab of the window finishes and waits for you, the game pauses and names that tab, with a button to go to it. Reads only the window's tab statuses; never types into a session, runs nothing and uses no network.
plugins.author: BronOS

plugins.name: Gitea / Forgejo
plugins.description: Your work on a Gitea or Forgejo server next to your Claude sessions: review requests (yours and your team's), your open pull requests with what happened last, issues assigned to you or mentioning you (and, if you like, the ones you opened), and your failed CI runs, with unread marks. An item opens in an overlay with the conversation, the checks, the changed files and, where the server has the API, the end of each failed job's log; Discuss with Claude hands it to a session. Signs in with a server address and an access token (bound to that server). Asks the server what it supports (Gitea 1.23 and newer, Forgejo). Writes only on your click: re-run failed jobs where the server can, mark the notification read. Provides an inbox-feed for Inbox, with the same labels as the GitHub plugin. Needs cc-cockpit 0.16.2.
plugins.author: BronOS

plugins.name: GitHub
plugins.description: Your GitHub work next to your Claude sessions: review requests (yours and your team's), your open pull requests with what happened last, issues assigned to you or mentioning you, and your failed CI runs, with unread marks. An item opens in an overlay with the conversation, the checks and the end of each failed job's log, and the changed files; Discuss with Claude hands it to a session. Signs in through the GitHub CLI (gh auth login), token in memory only. Writes only on your click: re-run failed jobs, mark the notification read or done. Provides an inbox-feed for Inbox, with labels from a shared code-host convention. Needs cc-cockpit 0.16.2.
plugins.author: BronOS

plugins.name: Gmail
plugins.description: Your Gmail in lanes (Unread, Alerts, Read), Grafana alerts grouped, sorted by Jev triage, mark read / unread. A thread opens in its own window in every view: Reader or Original, remote pictures only when you ask (through an optional proxy), notes, Ask and Discuss with Claude, and the linked Jira issue beside Jira mail (with bronos.jira). It only ever changes the read state: it never archives, labels, trashes or sends. Notes, Ask and the issue beside a mail need cc-cockpit 0.28.0.
plugins.author: BronOS

plugins.name: Inbox
plugins.description: One list of what needs you across Chat, Mail and Jira (any plugin that offers an inbox feed, version 2), placed in groups by your own rules (Jev questions included), with done, snooze, undo and search, and Calendar's agenda in a slot. It reads the other plugins through their services and has no account of its own. Needs cc-cockpit 0.10.0.
plugins.author: BronOS

plugins.name: Jev triage
plugins.description: Priority and kind for the items of source plugins (mail, Jira, chat), judged by Jev with project rules and your corrections: the "triage" plugin service.
plugins.author: BronOS

plugins.name: Jev
plugins.description: Jev, TypeSafe's cheap typed classifier, as the "jev" plugin service: other plugins ask choice, yes/no and score questions (one request, or a grid over many items). OpenRouter, TypeSafe direct or a custom endpoint; default model typesafe/jev-1.14; usage counted per calling plugin, with a monthly spending cap. Choices only, no free-form text generation.
plugins.author: BronOS

plugins.name: Jira
plugins.description: Your Jira Cloud issues in lanes (Backlog, In progress, Mentioned, On hold, Done), unread marks, sorted by Jev triage, discussed with Claude. An issue opens in its own window with notes, Ask and Reply (a comment or a status change); ccc jira update drafts one for you to post (or writes directly, or is off: a setting). Shows the issue beside a Gmail mail or a calendar event that names it. Provides the jira service (issue status, the issue window) to other plugins, such as bronos.gmail, and an inbox-feed of your issues for Inbox. Notes, Ask and the issue beside a mail need cc-cockpit 0.28.0.
plugins.author: BronOS

plugins.name: Kozel
plugins.description: Kozel (the goat), the Soviet courtyard domino game, in a panel to play while Claude works: four players in two pairs with a computer partner and two computer opponents, 28 tiles of a double-six set, first to 101. The 1-1 opens the first round, the chain snakes to fit the panel, a player who goes out scores the opponents' pips and a blocked game (the fish) goes to the lightest hand; a team still at zero when the other reaches 101 is the goat. When a Claude tab of the window finishes and waits for you, the game pauses and names that tab, with a button to go to it. Reads only the window's tab statuses; never types into a session, runs nothing and uses no network.
plugins.author: BronOS

plugins.name: Mines
plugins.description: A mine-finding puzzle in a panel, to play while Claude works. Five boards from 9×9 to 30×16, a safe first click, flags (right-click or a Flag mode), opening around a number, keyboard play, and your best time per board. When a Claude tab of the window finishes and waits for you, the game pauses and names that tab, with a button to go to it. Reads only the window's tab statuses; never types into a session, runs nothing and uses no network.
plugins.author: BronOS

plugins.name: Omarchy Theme
plugins.description: Makes cc-cockpit match your Omarchy desktop. Pick the theme "Omarchy" in Settings › Appearance and it follows whichever Omarchy theme is active: switch Omarchy from Tokyo Night to Catppuccin, Rose Pine or a light theme, and the app, its panels and the Claude terminals re-colour within a second, with no restart. How it works: the plugin reads the palette Omarchy writes for the active theme (~/.local/state/omarchy/current/theme/colors.toml) and maps it onto the app's colours: background and bar shades, text, accent, borders, session status dots, tab flags. The terminal gets the same 16 colours as Omarchy's own terminal, so a Claude tab matches the terminal next to it. It only reads those files; it runs no commands and sends nothing anywhere. Without Omarchy (another desktop, or a Mac) it is a Tokyo Night theme. Needs cc-cockpit 0.15.0 or later.
plugins.author: BronOS

plugins.name: Solitaire
plugins.description: Classic seven-column patience in a panel, to play while Claude works. Tap a card and it goes where it fits, or drag it to choose; Draw 1 or Draw 3, unlimited undo, a Finish button once every card is face up, and games won and best time per draw mode. Cards scale with the panel, suit symbols are always shown and a four-colour deck is a setting. When a Claude tab of the window finishes and waits for you, the game pauses and names that tab, with a button to go to it. Reads only the window's tab statuses; never types into a session, runs nothing and uses no network.
plugins.author: BronOS

plugins.name: Team
plugins.description: Run a team of Claude tabs. Start a team, then hire members from a kickoff file (with model, effort and folder): each opens as a Claude tab in a split pane beside you, stacked in a column. Members talk through cc-cockpit Rooms (messages and shared docs) and ask you questions with ccc team ask; the Team panel shows what waits on you (answer in place), every member's state, cost, context and time, the room's activity and docs, and the team's numbers. End exports the docs, log and metrics to a folder and closes the tabs the hire opened (never yours or one you typed in). A tool, not a flow: no roles, phases or personas; bring your own kickoff files and skills. Runs only Claude tabs in this project and writes only the export folder you choose. Needs cc-cockpit 0.22.0 or later (Rooms from 0.19.1).
plugins.author: BronOS

plugins.name: Theme Pack
plugins.description: 21 colour themes for cc-cockpit, on any system: Tokyo Night, Catppuccin Mocha and Latte, Rosé Pine Dawn, Nord, Gruvbox, Everforest, Kanagawa, Flexoki Light, Miasma, and Omarchy's own (Matte Black, Ethereal, Vantablack, White and more); 5 of them light. Pick one in Settings › Appearance. Each theme colours the app, its panels and the Claude terminals (the 16 terminal colours of the scheme). The palettes are the ones Omarchy ships, with the same mapping as the Omarchy Theme plugin, so a theme here matches it exactly. Plain theme files: the plugin runs no code.
plugins.author: BronOS

plugins.name: Tiles
plugins.description: Sliding number tiles in a panel, to play while Claude works. Slide with the arrows, WASD or a swipe, merge equal tiles and reach the gold tile; three boards (4×4, 5×5, 6×6), one step of undo and your best score per board. When a Claude tab of the window finishes and waits for you, the game pauses and names that tab, with a button to go to it. Reads only the window's tab statuses; never types into a session, runs nothing and uses no network.
plugins.author: BronOS

plugins.name: Example
plugins.description: A click counter to copy as a starting point for your own plugin. One panel, one setting, one command.
